newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index up at noon on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index up at noon on speculative buying.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index was sharply up at midday on Tuesday on speculative institutional buying in stocks of big firms, brokers said.
The index surged 2.929 points or 3.45 percent to 87.888 points on volume of 6.236 million shares worth $4.704 million.

Brokers said domestic institutions which suffered losses in last week's market falls were trying to push up stocks in companies which weigh heavily on the index, including Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co and Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co.
"The morning's rise was mainly due to speculative institutional buying with market fundamentals having changed little," said one broker. "This is reflected in the thin volume."
Brokers said they believed the index would continue to rise but at a slower pace for the rest of Tuesday's session supported by gains amongst the shares of major firms.
But the emergence of another solid upward trend with active trading would require some more positive market-moving news, they said.
Of 43 B shares, 33 traded, with 28 up, four flat and one down.

Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the star on speculative institutional buying on news that its extra 100 million B shares are to be listed on Friday, surging $0.080 or 8.88 percent to $0.980 on volume of 39,700 shares.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi followed, jumping $0.110 or 7.48 percent to $1.580 on volume of 243,500 shares.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on domestic buying, up $0.024 or 3.32 percent to $0.746 on volume 1.1 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index continued its rebound but trading was sluggish, brokers said, adding that upward potential will be limited with more clampdown measures possible, brokers said.
The index rose 18.607 points or 1.32 percent to 1,425.079 on volume of 210.9 million shares worth 2.7 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index put on 47.797 points or 1.22 percent to 3,970.086 points.
Shanghai Narcisscus Electric Appliances Industrial was the star on speculative buying, surging 0.71 yuan or 9.94 percent to 7.85 yuan on volume of 328,200 shares.
